Interface UI

All Known Implementing Classes:
ConnectionScene, CustomScene, GUI, InGameScene, InLobbyScene, LobbyChoiceScene, MainScene, TUI
public interface UI
The generalized View interface for the client-side application. Defines the updates that the local model and controller can display in the User Interface, without distinction between GUI and TUI.
